RESTORE

A balcony needs a complete system.

Water getting into the unit below? We investigate the cause, assess the existing system and scope the restoration. Our crew can coordinate the strip-out, screed, waterproofing, tiling and sealing.

SOUND FAMILIAR?

Start with
what you can see.

  • Water stains or leaks below a balcony
  • Leaks returning after re-grouting or patching
  • Poor drainage or water ponding against walls

THE SCOPE

A system, step by step.

The written scope establishes what your particular building needs.

  1. 01

    Strip-out & preparation

    Remove the existing tiles and failed material back to a suitable substrate.

  2. 02

    Correct the falls

    Lay screed so the surface drains towards the waste.

  3. 03

    Install the membrane

    Prepare and detail the waterproofing system at edges, joints and penetrations.

  4. 04

    Tile & seal

    Relay tiles, grout and seal, with a documented handover.

A FEW PRACTICAL ANSWERS

Before you
get started.

All common questions
Will new grout solve the leak?

It depends on the cause. Re-grouting will not repair a failed waterproofing membrane. An investigation comes before a recommendation.

Do we need a separate tiler?

Hydro-Tec offers the restoration as one coordinated scope, including screeding, waterproofing, tiling and sealing.
